nonblocking_findings.description: The recorded whitespace check is 'git diff --check -- docs-site .github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml' with no commit range, so it compares the working tree against the index only. With the review content already committed at headCommit 6f419fd, the command cannot detect whitespace defects in the reviewed change; its empty log digest (01ba4719..., the sha256 of a single newline) is empty by construction. I independently confirmed by grep that docs-site contains no trailing whitespace, so no actual defect is hidden, but the check as recorded does not establish that.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Change the command in docs-site/scripts/review-release-024.py:334 to a range form such as ['git','diff','--check','382d9a0876c569c8349cd0db0096635f2494389b..HEAD','--','docs-site','.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml'] so the committed delta is actually inspected.

nonblocking_findings.description: The governance branch validates passed/source_sha256/qualifiedSourceSha256/qualifiedReleaseRoot and the published-source binding, but never asserts governance['scope'] == 'post_publication_governance' (the field is emitted, see attempt-01.checks.json:70) and never asserts that source_sha256 differs from qualifiedSourceSha256 and from the published archive digest. A future guard that returned the same hash for both identities would pass, which is exactly the conflation the governance scope is meant to prevent.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Add assertions that governance['scope'] == 'post_publication_governance' and that governance['source_sha256'] not in (governance['qualifiedSourceSha256'], registry['archiveSha256']), with a regression case in docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py.

nonblocking_findings.description: delivery_records() indexes delivery['ci_receipt'] directly while every neighbouring lookup uses .get() plus an explicit ValueError. A phase record missing ci_receipt raises KeyError, which is not in the top-level except clause at line 429 ((ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError)), so the runner would abort with a traceback instead of the intended single-line failure message.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Read ci_receipt with .get(), validate it against the same docs/checks/phase-28-remote-ci-run-<n>.json pattern as ci_observation, and raise ValueError with a named predicate when it is missing or malformed.

The workflow is intentionally unchanged this cycle and is the authorized delivery mechanism, so this is a follow-up, not a prerequisite.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: In a separate reviewed change, either exclude '!docs-site/scripts/**' from the push paths or relocate the review runner outside docs-site/; do not modify the workflow as part of this documentation release.
